channel.title: Badlands Media – Bias and Credibility - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Badlands Media – Bias and Credibility (badlandsmedia.tv)

item.title: Araghchi Meets With Putin in Russia, Blames U.S. for Failed Negotiations - Badlands Media
item.description: Iran’s foreign minister Abbas Araghchi is currently meeting in Russia with President Vladimir Putin and Foreign Minister Sergey Lavrov, for talks centered on the ongoing Middle East conflict.

item.title: DOJ Demands End to Lawsuit Blocking Trump Ballroom Project After Security Fears Raised - Badlands Media
item.description: The Justice Department is urging the National Trust for Historic Preservation (NTHP) to withdraw its lawsuit aimed at halting President Trump’s privately funded White House ballroom project, warning that if the case is not withdrawn by Monday morning, the DOJ will move to dissolve the existing injunction blocking construction and seek dismissal in court.

item.title: Supreme Court Clears Texas Redistricting Map, Reverses Lower Court Ruling - Badlands Media
item.description: The Supreme Court on Monday lifted a lower court injunction blocking Texas’ new congressional map, handing a victory to Republican-led state officials ahead of the 2026 midterm elections.

item.title: Russia Deepens Military Ties With North Korea During High-Level Visit And Memorial Ceremony - Badlands Media
item.description: Russian Defense Minister Andrei Belousov and State Duma Chairman Vyacheslav Volodin visited North Korea over the weekend to expand military cooperation and honor North Korean troops who fought alongside Russia in Ukraine.

item.title: President, First Lady Call For Action Against Kimmel Following Controversial Monologue - Badlands Media
item.description: President Trump and First Lady Melania Trump issued statements condemning late-night host Jimmy Kimmel, accusing him of promoting divisive and dangerous rhetoric targeting their family that deepens the political sickness within America, with Trump calling for Kimmel to be immediately fired.

item.title: Trump Signals Potential Wind-Down of Middle East Military Operations - Badlands Media
item.description: President Trump indicated U.S. military operations in the Middle East may soon be winding down as objectives related to Iran near completion, stating the United States and Iran have held “very good and productive conversations” over the past two days aimed at a “complete and total resolution” of hostilities, with talks continuing throughout the week.

item.title: Pentagon Moves to Formalize Palantir’s Maven AI System as Long-Term Military Program - Badlands Media
item.description: Palantir Technologies’ Maven AI system is being formally adopted by the U.S. military, securing its long-term use for identifying and tracking targets, according to a directive from Deputy War Secretary Steve Feinberg.

item.title: Nunes Says Intelligence Board Will Probe Alleged Political Bias in China Election Intel - Badlands Media
item.description: The civilian board overseeing U.S. intelligence agencies will investigate whether political bias prevented analysts from sharing evidence with Congress and President Trump regarding alleged Chinese election interference, according to chairman Devin Nunes.

item.title: Up to 1.9 Million Pages of Records Found in Secured Room at FBI Headquarters - Badlands Media
item.description: The Federal Bureau of Investigation has identified as many as 1.9 million pages of records in response to a Freedom of Information Act lawsuit, materials reportedly stored inside a secret room at FBI headquarters.

item.title: Senate Confirms Markwayne Mullin to Lead DHS - Badlands Media
item.description: The Senate confirmed Markwayne Mullin as Secretary of Homeland Security in a 54-45 vote, with Democratic Sens. John Fetterman and Martin Heinrich supporting the nomination.

item.title: New Jersey Judges Install New U.S. Attorney After Leadership Dispute - Badlands Media
item.description: Federal judges in New Jersey on Monday appointed a new top prosecutor, a move backed by the U.S. Department of Justice that signals a resolution to the dispute over leadership of the state’s U.S. attorney’s office.

item.title: Department Of War Relocates Pentagon Press To Annex Under New Policy - Badlands Media
item.description: The Department of War said Monday it will restructure press access at the Pentagon, relocating journalists to an external annex facility while maintaining controlled entry into the building.

item.title: U.S.-Iran Meeting Could Be Convened in Pakistan - Badlands Media
item.description: Mediating countries are working to arrange a meeting in Islamabad, Pakistan, between the United States and Iran, with talks aimed at ending the conflict potentially taking place as soon as later this week, according to an unnamed Israeli official.

item.title: NYT: Saudi Crown Prince Urges Continued Pressure on Iran - Badlands Media
item.description: Saudi Arabia’s de facto leader, Mohammed bin Salman, has been urging President Trump to continue military pressure on Iran, arguing the U.S.-Israeli campaign presents a “historic opportunity” to reshape the Middle East, according to The New York Times, citing individuals briefed by American officials.

item.title: NASA Accelerates Plan for Permanent Moon Base With More Frequent Missions - Badlands Media
item.description: NASA said it is accelerating plans to establish a permanent presence on the Moon, with a goal of sending missions more frequently as systems and partnerships develop. The agency is targeting lunar landings as often as every six months, as part of a broader effort to build toward a sustained Moon base.
